title: Lysergic Acid Diethylamide: Side Effects and Complications
author: Sidney Cohen
summary: Sidney Cohen surveyed researchers at the VA Neuropsychiatric Hospital who had administered LSD or mescaline to nearly 5,000 subjects across more than 25,000 doses. He found no cases of serious prolonged physical harm and quantified low rates of suicide attempts, psychotic breaks over 48 hours, and other adverse effects.
citation: Sidney Cohen, "Lysergic Acid Diethylamide: Side Effects and Complications," Journal of Nervous and Mental Disease 130, no. 1 (January 1960): 30–40.
rights: In copyright (Wolters Kluwer / Ovid). No US Government interest — Cohen wrote in his VA capacity but this is a journal publication, not a VA report.
